indexes.title: Kakubin: Japan monthly city-price median
indexes.primary_publisher: Statistics Bureau of Japan, Ministry of Internal Affairs and Communications
indexes.dataset_title: Retail Price Survey (Trend Survey): retail prices of major items by prefectural capital and cities with population of at least 150,000, January 2000 onward
indexes.method: Nedan Hakusho calculates the median of the available city retail-price observations from the Japanese government Retail Price Survey, item 2033. This import transcribes each exact visible nationwide monthly chart tooltip. Missing city observations are not supplied by this import. It does not recompute or independently verify the city median from the primary government raw records.
indexes.notes: A survey-based nationwide contextual series, kept separate from individual retailer offers, manufacturer recommendations, transactions, and strictly comparable bottle-format price histories. The source joins observations across July 2005 and January 2007 survey-specification changes because adjacent price levels are similar. No day, exact ABV, historical city count, missing observation, exchange-rate conversion, inflation adjustment, or continuous identical product formulation has been inferred.

indexes.extraction_details: Opened the public item page in a separate Brave research tab. Focused the accessible nationwide SVG chart and used the Left key to expose each month in descending order; read the exact visible date and JPY price after each key. Checked all 321 unique consecutive months and cross-checked the final 12 months against the rendered HTML table, plus 2006/2016 September and the published price extrema. Direct HTTP CSV returned 403 and documented browser CSV download attempts did not complete, so no CSV bytes or CSV hash are claimed.
indexes.hash_scope: SHA-256 of UTF-8 canonical JSON evidence_facts (sorted keys, ensure_ascii=false, separators comma/colon); the 321 exact date/value pairs read from visible chart tooltips. Not raw HTML, a downloaded CSV, government raw city records, or a page screenshot.
indexes.attribution: Processed from the Retail Price Survey (Trend Survey), Statistics Bureau of Japan, by Nedan Hakusho. Nationwide values are the median of surveyed cities. Nedan Hakusho is an independent private service and its computations are not produced or endorsed by the government.
